entry.name: Supermium 144 (portable)
entry.verified: supermium_144_32_nonsetup.zip SHA-256 17acfcdf89ea651905053b50b0fce5a28db19cb2c69ed5579c7b177806ed6d31 matches the digest GitHub publishes for the asset (api.github.com releases/tags/v144-r5); all 295/297 unpacked files copied, file count and byte total match on the VM; chrome.exe unsigned (osslsigncode: no signature), FileVersion 144.0.7559.256
entry.notes: Portable install (nonsetup zip, win32) unpacked to C:\ibbrowsers\supermium-144, alongside the installed Supermium 122 (id supermium-installed). Starts headless from the SSH session with only --headless=new (no --no-sandbox or --disable-gpu-rasterization needed): DevTools on 127.0.0.1 reports Chrome/144.0.7559.256, protocol 1.3; over CDP via ssh -L, file:///C:/ibbrowsers/smoke.html -> UA 'HeadlessChrome/144.0.0.0' (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64 spoof), isSecureContext true, crypto.subtle true. No driver: official CfT chromedriver 144.0.7559.133 (win32, storage.googleapis.com, zip MD5 matched x-goog-hash) does not load: its PE header requires OS/subsystem version 10.0, so CreateProcess fails with ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT (Python WinError 193 '%1 is not a valid Win32 application') (from a plain cmd.exe over SSH it instead hangs silently with no output). Folder removed. Drive over the DevTools protocol through ssh -L (protocol: cdp), as for Supermium 122.

served: no tunnel: Error: remote port forwarding failed for listen port 36956
